Thesis, supervision and current position of our doctoral graduates. This page complements the [official website of the PhD programme](https://www.dems.unimib.it/en/programmes/post-lauream/phd-economics-statistics-and-data-science), which remains the reference for admission, regulations and courses. Current students are listed [here](students.qmd).

## Statistics curriculum, since cycle XXXIV

Graduates of the Statistics curriculum of the PhD in Economics, Statistics and Data Science, from its first cohort (cycle XXXIV, enrolled in 2018). Affiliations are shown for supervisors outside Milano-Bicocca.

## Earlier doctoral programmes

Before 2018 doctoral training in statistics at Milano-Bicocca ran through other programmes: Statistics, Statistics and Applications, and Statistics and Mathematical Finance. The list covers the theses deposited in the [BOA institutional repository](https://boa.unimib.it) from 2010 onwards. Supervision is taken from the title page of each thesis; where the title page names only a tutor, the tutor is listed as supervisor. Current positions in Italian universities come from the [MUR register of academic staff](https://cercauniversita.mur.gov.it); the others are still to be completed.
